explicit_finish.description: New admissions default to explicit callback completion: turn completion waits for events; only private finish ends the run. False selects legacy compatibility. No lifetime timeout.

idle_ping.description: Frozen health policy: observe invokes no model; recover permits one model control turn per task-progress episode; off preserves explicit holds. No automatic cancellation.

required_mcp.description: Non-grant assertion on frozen selected MCP servers and exact unprefixed tools. Empty lists require server presence. Omitted or empty map adds no condition; null and duplicates are invalid.

Raw rows remain the default; view=blocks groups only consecutive known native identities. tail_blocks returns the last 1..200 blocks; use previous_cursor as before_cursor for older pages, or next_cursor as cursor for forward pages. Partial blocks and omitted inline content are explicit; raw_ref stays opaque.

description: Continue the latest terminal execution of a stable agent in the same native context. agent_id stays constant. Concurrent continuations cannot create parallel active runs. Reuse request_id for an identical retry, including after later resumes. Identity, permissions, native-history and cleanup checks remain mandatory. Replays are idempotent only with the same nonempty request_id and identical arguments; without a key each call may admit new work. Executions have no wall-clock limit; completion, failure or explicit cancellation ends a run. Native continuations may be resumed repeatedly.

name: doc

description: Before delegating any task, the orchestrator MUST call this tool and read its output before choosing a provider, model, effort, or profile. Do not route from a remembered model list or a separate delegation skill. Returns a compact plain-text guide from current configuration: providers in configured order, exact models, admissible profiles, supported parameters, restrictions, and configured recommendations. It carries no quota standing; read current capacity from Agent Quota. The orchestrator makes the task-specific choice; the broker selects the account unless explicitly pinned and refuses an exhausted choice with QuotaExhausted. Follow the start/resume tool contracts for launch, binding, continuation and verified results. Read-only; schema_version 1 is Unsupported. Configured recommendations are guidance, not an automatic model-ability ranking. Optional provider, model and profile filters are exact configured names; unknown names return ValidationError. Omitted filters retain the compact default guide.
name: delegation_guide

description: Atomically admit 1–20 independent ordinary agents, or admit none. request_id is required and permanently identifies the ordered normalized request in this Run home. Identical retries return the same receipt and never start replacements; changed intent conflicts. Admission is durable before separate supervisor handoffs; it does not prove every process started or completed. Preserve every agent_id, sequence and opaque execution_ref and inspect status yourself. Automatic multi-agent hook binding is not provided; pass an explicit orchestrator per job when needed. Optional preconditions require expected_store_id and 1–20 exact pinned terminal executions with confirmed lineage cleanup; any terminal outcome may qualify. The ordered list is part of the receipt and replay identity. A PreconditionFailed applies to this attempt only and never resolves an earlier unknown outcome. The whole encoded request must fit the existing transport and writer limits.
